payload.purpose_context: The synth loads fifteen instruments but the controller can only edit the first one. This mission assembles the full PATCH editing experience in the webview shell — patch identity and routing, instrument selection, ordered effects, the ADSR block, and a persistent Utility panel — and supplies the state behind the designed-but-undriven controls carried forward from the component library phase. It closes with a live hardware demonstration that navigates from one patch to another and edits a second instrument audibly, which is the outstanding half of the long-standing single-instrument limitation.
payload.purpose_tldr: Make every installed instrument reachable and editable from the PATCH surface, and prove it on hardware.

payload.wp_title: Canonical voice limit and its real-time enforcement
Widened PATCH control surface and reducer
The composed PATCH surface in the webview page
The live scene, its target, and the roadmap close
